Now nobody told Claude what treatment to pick or how to execute the operation. The only instructions they gave it were to reduce the seizures. Epilepsy causes too many of the brain's neurons to get overly excited at the same time.
So Claude decided to use a gene therapy that
would boost the brain's natural calming signal.

skull and had a kill switch in case anything went wrong, but

incredible milestone in

out less than four

general purpose LLMs
